Definition: Ethan, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ethan is the name of four Israelites. In 1 Kings 4:31, the text says "than Ethan the Ezrahite." The life behind the name is told on the Ethan People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ethan matters because God knows His people by name, and Ethan is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
